text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see~.
So you want to somehow reinvent yourself this summer into someone people have high hopes for!?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yes! Isn't there any way...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
At times like that, the answer is simple!
Bakushin, bakushiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—When all I needed was energy,
this lively vibe helped immensely.
But right now, we're past that stage.
choice_data_list: Kitasan, let's talk with the other horse girls tonight.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thank you very much,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And—at night.
Together with Vodka and Gold Ship,
I came to a small ramen shop near the training camp.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I see. Having no expectations on you, huh?
It sure sucks being constantly ignored like that.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Aye, aye, 'twas the same in my village too.
Ah, ma'am, an extra serving of noodles, please!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Both of the upperclassmen from the outlaw group listened to my story with genuine care.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Ever since I was little, I've always
wanted to live up to expectations and help people in need,
and that's how I've done things."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"So I'm not really used to this feeling
of not being needed right now.
I thought maybe I was getting in the way..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well, it all comes down to how you look at it.
Having low expectations can have its upside, too.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: After all, pulling off an upset when no one's watching is the coolest thing ever!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Turning the tables from out of nowhere...
Is that where you find your motivation,
Vodka-san...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah. If it were me, I'd dive right into where nobody expects me!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"And I'll overturn it all. Through pure ability.
That's just the way I live."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I feel the exact same way, Kitasan.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Golshi-san too?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, if anything, I do what people don't expect,
or what gets on their nerves!
'Cause that's just my way of life.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Nobody would do that.
Like striking a pose at the starting gate.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I definitely won't do that... Absolutely not!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Setting aside what Gold Ship said, having no expectations on you is certainly a chance to prove everyone wrong.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
“I don't think I can pull it off like the two of you, though...
Because...”

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
To barge into a place where you're not wanted
and earn their respect like that...
You really are amazing, Senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Well, you can't easily change your way of life, and there's no need to, either.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Being expected of, and meeting those expectations. If that is Kitasan's way of life...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Why does nobody expect anything from me?" 
Shouldn't you start from there first?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Why are there no expectations of me...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah. If no one's noticing me and I'm just getting overlooked, I gotta figure out how to get their attention from now on.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. This world belongs to you.
And what's yours is mine.
Simple as that.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I see, that's one way to look at it.
If you're not getting attention, you figure out a way to get it...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That was really helpful!
Though figuring out what to do from here is up to me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Well, glad I could help.
By the way!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"How did I do today?
Did I look like a cool senpai at all?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, I was way cooler.
After all, I'm the one who brought you to this ramen shop in the first place."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Right, ma'am?
This place is a hidden gem, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Lady
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. You always manage to bring someone along
to a shop way out on the edge of town like this.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: H-How about... we say both of them looked really cool?

text_block_list.name: Vodka & Golshi
text_block_list.text: Which one is it!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems I've sparked a strange rivalry between them.
If forced to say whose mindset influenced me more...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ooooooh, you totally get it!
Right, right? A windfall of cowberries!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Kitasan!
From now on, just smash through whatever door is in front of you!
Take this, that, and a flying knee strike!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, sometimes I have to be
a bit pushy...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship's brute-force way of living seems to have inspired Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Still, how am I supposed
to get people's attention?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, right, right, totally right!
The way I live resonated with you, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I can keep teaching you as much as you wantâabout what true strength of heart really is.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yes, please...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vodka's rebellious spirit
seemed to give Kitasan Black courage.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Still, how am I supposed
to get people's attention?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
If nobody expected anything from me from the start,
and working hard still won't change that,
then what am I supposed to do from here on out...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Instead of asking me that, ask the ramen shop lady.
What should we do, ma'am?

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Lady
Ramen Shop Lady
text_block_list.text: Just like how our shop gradually began to thrive. Here, take a look at the photos lined up over there.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: A photo of us standing side by side...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's... so many Umamusume...!
Golshi-san is there too. This photo is...

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Lady
text_block_list.text:
They're the Umamusume who've supported our place for a long time.
All those who have visited our training camp over the years, you see...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —After closing. Heading out to the beach, the lady shared fond memories with me.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Lady
text_block_list.text: Business was dead quiet at first. But then, Umamusume started stopping by every now and then...

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Lady
text_block_list.text:
And so, things gradually started getting lively.
Of course I was happy, but still...

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Lady
text_block_list.text:
"On the flip side—I've seen plenty of
tears from the Umamusume as well. Far too many."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Tears...? Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Lady
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, among the Umamusume who came to us,
there were girls who struggled to win and couldn't take the spotlight...

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Lady
text_block_list.text: There was this girl... She had plenty of skill and came close in the big races, but she just could never win...

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Lady
text_block_list.text: I was worried you might quit one day, but seeing your face every year always put my mind at ease.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Lady
text_block_list.text:
That girl kept gaining more and more attention...
and when she finally won a GⅠ, boy, it was
an absolute sensation!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Lady
text_block_list.text: Our shop has always been supported by Umamusume like them. All this time...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Is that so...?
Still, to finally win a GⅠ, just how long...

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Lady
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Roughly five years.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...5 years!?

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Lady
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that girl said it before.
'The Twinkle Series is like a "long journey."'

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Lady
text_block_list.text: The finish line is only at the very, very end. So until you get there, you just have to believe and keep moving forward, step by step.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Lady
text_block_list.text: "I'll never forget it. The way she spoke so matter-of-factly, and the faces of the other Umamusume slurping their ramen as they listened..."

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Lady
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, Golshi-chan. When that girl won, you were bawling your eyes out...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Shut up! That was just... the pepper stinging my ears, I told you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Even if I couldn't win...
For five whole years, the entire time...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"So that's how hard you've been pushing yourself, Senpai...
Locking away all that frustration deep inside your chest..."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: There are so many Umamusume like that at that ramen shop...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With tears glistening in her eyes,
Kitasan Black gazed up at the Milky Way stretching across the night sky.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A road that feels unending. Reflecting deeply on the feelings of the predecessors who walked it to the end.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this is just...
just too pathetic.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: What does it take to be expected of? Something like that... I knew it all along. I knew it all too well...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I still haven't built up enough good races!
I've only been running for a single year!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"It took our senior 5 years! 5 whole years!
It took her 5 years to finally do it!
And all the other seniors too!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
And yet, I'm...
I'm so...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All of Kitasan Black's frustration was directed
at herself—at yesterday's self, who had come
to a halt over petty worries.
choice_data_list: Let's win over the spotlight from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I won't complain anymore.
I just want to run, I just want to show everyone a great race!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I want to keep showing them.
So that people think, "She too is an Umamusume worthy of this shore."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
To this sea! To these waves! I swear!
I won't back down, not a single step!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'll become an Umamusume who won't lose to our senpais,
no matter what――!!
